exposure: exposure to household dogs during infancy
outcome: Association between food allergy and allergic diseases
Severity of asthma, rhinitis, and eczema symptoms
finding: The 12-month prevalence of study-defined food allergy was estimated to be 4.1% in schoolchildren in Kuwait, with more girls affected than boys, and study-defined food allergy was associated with the coexistence and increased severity of asthma, rhinitis, and eczema.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was associated with an increased prevalence of study-defined food allergy.
